verdict.rationale: SerpApi's integrations page tells users to "install the library for your language," and lists an official Python SDK (serpapi-python) as Available. The official GitHub Python client shows working usage code across many engines, though it is slated for deprecation in favor of the newer serpapi-python package. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of SDKs for languages beyond Python, documentation or hands-on corroboration of the newer serpapi-python SDK itself, and a published OpenAPI spec for generating clients (probes returned 404).
